en.headline: Police arrest 12 men in crackdown on illegal ride-hailing cars
en.dek: Five local and seven mainland men were held between 27 October and Thursday; seven mainland suspects have been charged and remanded while police step up checks near Kai Tak concerts.
body: Police arrested 12 men and seized 12 private cars in a citywide crackdown on illegal ride-hailing services, known locally as white-plate cars, between 27 October and Thursday.

The arrested men — five local and seven from the mainland aged between 27 and 58 — are suspected of using a private car for hire or carrying passengers for reward without a permit, and of driving without third-party risk insurance. Seven of the mainland men also allegedly breached conditions of stay. Ten of the seized vehicles carried both mainland and Hong Kong plates.

The five local men have been released on bail pending investigation. The seven mainland men have been formally charged and remanded in custody by court order. Police said the operation involved network checks, intelligence analysis and undercover actions across districts.

With large concerts at Kai Tak Stadium from Friday until Sunday and next Tuesday, the government urged travellers to use public transport such as the railway when leaving the venue and warned against using illegal cross-boundary taxis or unlicensed ride-hailing cars. Police said they would strengthen enforcement at waiting hotspots and, if evidence is sufficient, refer information to mainland authorities.

zh.headline: 警方兩周打擊白牌車拘12男 7名內地司機還押候審
zh.dek: 上月27日至周四行動中拘捕5名本地及7名內地男子，扣查12輛私家車；因應啟德演唱會警方加強巡查。
body: 警方過去兩星期透過網絡巡查、情報分析及喬裝行動，在全港多區打擊利用車輛作非法載客取酬的白牌車活動，拘捕12名男子並扣查12輛私家車。
被捕人士包括5名本地男子及7名持雙程證內地男子，年齡介乎27至58歲，涉嫌非法駕駛汽車作出租或載客取酬用途，以及駕駛時沒有第三者風險保險。7名內地男子另涉違反逗留條件。當中10輛涉案車輛持有內地及香港牌。
5名本地男子已獲准保釋候查，7名內地男子已被落案起訴，經法庭下令還押候審。警方表示會繼續打擊有關活動。
因應啟德主場館由周五至周日及下周二舉行大型演唱會，政府呼籲旅客離場時乘搭鐵路等公共交通，切勿乘坐非法跨境出租車或無牌白牌車。警方指會加強在候車黑點的執法及巡查，證據足夠時或將資料轉交內地相關部門跟進。
